name: Plenoptic Portable Neural Graphics (PPNG)
definition: A volumetric neural feature representation that maps 3D coordinates to color and opacity using a sinusoidal function encoded feature volume, allowing feature sharing by design to reduce parameters compared to spatial coordinate indexed volumes.
summary: Plenoptic Portable Neural Graphics is a compact volumetric representation using Fourier-indexed feature volumes to enable real-time neural rendering on low-cost GPUs with limited memory.
